messages:
sara: T-minus 25m for the window. Infra asked for a 20m freeze extension to stabilize autoscaling. Quick thumbs?

liam: What's the impact on the DB migration lock?

anya: DB migration still at the planned 2m lock, so extension is fine for us.

liam: Ok. I want an extra smoke run for embeddings after pin if we accept.

ops-bot: Proposed extension: +20m. Vote: :thumbsup: to approve, :thumbsdown: to deny.

sara: Approve. We delay pin by 10m to run warmup.

anya: Approved. I'll prep the support blurb and have rollback messaging ready.

liam: Plan for pin sequence: pin eu-west -> wait 7m verify -> pin us-central -> expand. I'll run deploy-bot commands.

deploy-bot: Reminder: use /deploy pin --service api --version v2.8.0 --region <region> --owner @liam. Smoke tests auto-run post-pin.

sara: Rollback triggers: sustained error rate >2% for 5m OR p95 +200ms sustained 5m OR eval failures on golden prompts. If hit, call rollback and deploy-bot will unpin.

liam: Running eu-west pin now.

deploy-bot: Pin executed by @liam at 5271234620 -- service=api region=eu-west-1 version=v2.8.0

sara: eu-west pinned. Running smoke. Keep channel open for 20m.

ops-bot: Alert suppression applied for non-critical thresholds for 12m per @sara request.

liam: Metrics steady at +5m. Proceeding to us-central pin.

deploy-bot: Pin executed by @liam at 5271234680 -- service=api region=us-central1 version=v2.8.0

sara: All pins complete. Gradual rollout in progress. Channel stays warm for 45m.

-- thread end --
